title: Electron-deficient and multicentre bonding
basic_overview: Electron-deficient species use multicentre bonding when localised 2c–2e structures are insufficient.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Valence-electron count. 2. Skeleton. 3. Identify electron deficiency. 4. Add bridge/multicentre description.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
